writtenBefore: any idle98 probe (committed before the first probe job; the Dynamic Punch miss-seed search is staging, not a measurement)

definitions.G: ROM: last screen change before F_att (the final glyph of 'X used Y!' or, for a later multi-hit body, the last change of the previous hit)
definitions.F_att / A / E / F_after: idle94Compare.py anchors: first frame on the attackanimation byte X, gAnimScriptActive rise, first inactive frame, first frame on X+2
definitions.F_hit: ROM: first frame on X+3 (hitanimation, after effectivenesssound) for the hit path

rom.pre: 3 on EVERY Scene ON body: damaging (single hit, each multi-hit body, two-turn charge + strike, KO hit), both sides, and the Tackle bodies of the targets
rom.preRows: F_att .. A-1 are one static image equal to F_att-1 (first body: the printed 'X used Y!' text)
rom.postRows: E .. F_after-1 equal the ROM's first inactive row E (the row production shows last when trail = -1)
rom.offSpan: Scene OFF F_after - F_att = 35 on every damaging body (Cmd_attackanimation pushes BattleScript_Pausex20 in OFF)
rom.modeIndependent: F_att - G and F_hit - F_after are equal in ON and OFF (only the attackanimation .. waitanimation span depends on the scene)
rom.miss: a Dynamic Punch miss has NO attackanimation (accuracycheck jumps to BattleScript_MoveMissedPause: attackstring, ppreduce, pause B_WAIT_TIME_SHORT): no body, the same pause in ON and OFF

production.hitOff: production's OFF hit path (move-animation 1 + interveningInstructions + 32 = 42 on BattleScript_EffectHit moves) equals the ROM OFF G -> F_hit span up to one fixed message-anchor constant shared by every hit-path move: OFF loses 0
production.hitOn: production's ON hit path loses L_hit = (span_ON - 35) - (D - 42) = 12 + N + trail frames per body (= the status class L + 7: the release -> F_att and F_after -> hitanimation frames production's OFF formula counts and its ON command does not). Karate Chop (N 0, trail -1): 11; Psychic (5, -1): 16; Bite (10, 4): 26; Earthquake (0, 9): 21
production.statusOn: L = pre + N + trail + post (idle94); Bulk Up 8
production.statusOff: 35 (no command for the attackanimation -> Pausex20 -> waitanimation span when there is no hit receipt)
production.multiHit: every multi-hit body (Double Kick hit 1 and 2) loses the same per-body L as a single hit with its own N / trail
production.twoTurnCharge: the charge turn is a no-hit body: ON L = pre + N + trail + post, OFF 35 (like a status move)
production.rowsReproducible: pre rows = production's age-0 frame's predecessor image (the printed message, already displayed by the message command); post rows = production's last row on lead-0 / trail -1 moves
